subject.title: fix(google-meet): bound Meet v2 + Drive files.export request deadlines

question: Should Google Meet v2 and Drive export helper calls fail closed after a hardcoded 30s default deadline?
rationale: The implementation uses an existing timeout seam and fixes a real hang class, but it changes previously unbounded Google API waits into default failures for existing users.

options.title: Accept 30s default
options.body: Proceed with this branch because the cap matches the active timeout campaign and bounds indefinite plugin hangs without adding config.

options.title: Use existing operation timeout
options.body: Ask the PR to inherit an existing command or gateway operation timeout where available, with 30s only as a fallback.

options.title: Defer timeout policy
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define one policy for Calendar, Meet v2, Drive export, and OAuth timeout behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept 30s default
recommendation.body: Proceed with this branch because the cap matches the active timeout campaign and bounds indefinite plugin hangs without adding config.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the current Google Meet API helper surface and adjacent bounded-response hardening, which is the best available routing signal for the default-timeout contract decision.
